title: House of Graphs witness ledger

contribution.claim: A verified, citable collection of 26 House of Graphs witness graphs, each stored byte-exact as graph6 and accepted only when two implementations that share no code verify its defining property.
contribution.scope: Each record states its own claim kind and dated prior art; the ledger itself asserts verification of the witnesses, not novelty. Witnesses establish attainment; exact values rest on the lower-bound evidence in each record's cited archive.

attribution.house_of_graphs: House of Graphs hosts the deposited graphs: Brinkmann, Coolsaet, Goedgebeur, Melot, doi:10.1016/j.dam.2012.07.018; Coolsaet, D'hondt, Goedgebeur, doi:10.1016/j.dam.2022.10.013 (checked via Crossref 2026-10-22).
attribution.prior_art: Per-record prior-art entries credit Zhang--Luo--Shigeno, Lan et al., Erdos--Hajnal--Moon and the OEIS; see each record page.
attribution.software: Python, PyYAML and NetworkX retain specific credit.
attribution.ai_assistance: Substantial Claude Code and OpenAI Codex assistance in implementation, checking and writing.

limitations: No human peer-review or proof-assistant verification claim.
8 records are unassessed for prior art and make no novelty claim.
Bounded literature searches do not establish global novelty or priority.
